Clan: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} (clan-specific; may not be taken by outsiders at character creation)

Outsiders often interpret the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.WaQFCEXFzv8YeAgX]{Assamite} belief in the Path of Blood as a simple desire for increased power through diablerie. The truth is much more complex, embedded in the teachings of Haqim (the Assamite founder), which form the central motivation for the clan. The Path of Blood teaches that it will lead to the downfall of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, turning their own strength against them, fulfilling the Assamites' revenge for their sufferings and carrying out Haqim's sacred task of ridding the world of the Kindred.

The second, more mystical teaching holds that the Path of Blood ascends the peak of Alamut, and the Assamite who climbs the Path of Blood to the summit shall become One — an enlightenment directly comparable to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} idea of Golconda. Only by reaching the summit may an Assamite become One. The Camarilla are allowed to carry on believing that Assamites follow the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.db3Fhvpv32rhN3Mm]{Path of Caine}, since this serves the Great Disguise and prevents outsiders from learning their true goal: the destruction of all Caine's progeny.

Hierarchy of Sins (most to least severe):

  1. Failing to pursue an opportunity to obtain Kindred blood of a higher generation than your own, though it may cost your unlife.
  2. Succumbing to frenzy.
  3. Failing to pursue Kindred blood or knowledge of Caine or the Curse when there is moderate danger.
  4. Being disrespectful to clan leaders.
  5. Failing to execute an assassination contract yet surviving.
  6. Failing to pursue blood or knowledge in the face of minor danger.
  7. Not killing a non-Assamite vampire when there is need to do so.
  8. Placing personal desires or ambition above other matters.
  9. Failing to assist or avenge a clanmate.
  10. Revealing clan information to outsiders.

Path Traits: Assamites on the Path of Blood may also choose from the Path Traits Abelite, Self-Controlled, or Scholar (as described for the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.paths-of-enlightenment.JournalEntry.db3Fhvpv32rhN3Mm]{Path of Caine}).

  • Avenger — You believe in clan loyalty above all else. If anyone attempts to stop you or a clanmate from assisting or avenging a fellow Assamite, you succumb to a bloody killing haze to accomplish your goal.
  • Disrespect — Frenzy whenever you see a fellow Assamite treat a higher-ranking Assamite with disrespect of any sort.
  • Failure — If you, or a fellow Assamite you are aware of, fail in an assassination attempt, your self-esteem drops you into a frenzy-ridden depression of low morale.
  • Traitor — If you are forced to reveal clan secrets to others, you succumb to frenzy. Frenzy if you become aware of an Assamite betraying the clan, or if you see a non-clanmate using powers or information learnable only through an Assamite teaching (and betrayal).
